overview: Crosshaul is a 3D logistics puzzle with eight chambers. Choose two hovering cargo cubes and swap only one coordinate between them, preserving each cube’s other coordinates. Height, depth, shelves and screens turn a simple exchange into a routing problem, and later rooms add a fourth cargo.
rules: Select two cargoes and a world axis, then exchange only that coordinate; both cargoes slide together.
Both complete routes must be clear of baffles and other cargo.
Match every cargo to its color-and-symbol dock within the exchange allowance.
Docked cargo can move again. Rejected or equal-coordinate exchanges cost nothing; undo refunds a used exchange.
There is no timer; finish all eight chambers.
controls: Left click the cubes/list or use 1–4 to select two; X/Y/Z select width/height/depth; Space exchanges.
Right drag orbits; wheel zooms; the movement axes stay fixed.
Backspace undoes, even during travel or after failure; R retries; Enter advances a clear.
H offers one legal hint; Tab shows rules; F5/F9 save/load; Escape opens the menu; F fullscreen.

design.rationale:
Every move solves two transportation problems at once—or solves one while creating another. The satisfying discovery is treating another cube as a carrier for the height or depth you need. A nearly finished cube may be the only useful partner, making temporary disorder part of a clean final solution. Twin movement trails and synchronized docking clicks make the consequences tangible.

A useful comparison is The Swapper, which creates clones and transfers consciousness between bodies. Crosshaul instead moves two existing objects by exchanging one coordinate, coupling their physical routes. [The Swapper's official description](https://store.steampowered.com/app/231160/The_Swapper/). Among the supplied concepts, Color Custody exchanges behavioral ownership; Crosshaul exchanges spatial components. Perspective Pocket changes placement through silhouette constraints; Crosshaul is independent of camera perspective and preserves coordinate inventories. This appears distinct from the supplied mechanics, but worldwide originality and fun cannot be certified.
